field_text_formatted.value: With the secret of a consumer set up for Simple OAuth in DRUXT_NODE_PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET, Nuxt adds its target to Drupal when it starts and every six hours, and removes it on a clean shutdown. A target that stops registering goes inactive after a day, so a crashed server cleans up after itself. With token on and Druxt's API proxy, the read never leaves the frontend's origin, and Drupal's CORS stays as it is.
